reponse: The root cause was disk exhaustion on Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2, after the retention change in infra PR #221 removed size-based retention; the broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC and consumers stalled [2]. Slack confirms the disk at 100% and the broker read-only [3]. The earlier suspect, PR #388's batch-size change, was a red herring: reverting it did not stop the lag [1][3], and the batch size was later called fine and re-applied [5]. Impact was up to 2h47m of delay with no event lost [2].
